title: Goldilocks and the SOS pathway: Finding “just right” for growth after salt stress
content: As the story goes, Goldilocks had the luxury of choosing her ideal porridge, chair, and bed, before fleeing the bears’ house. Plants, however, must endure whatever conditions they encounter, whether they are or are not “just right.” And unlike Goldilocks, who lived in a fairytale, plants face escalating pressure as climate change pushes environmental conditions to further extremes.
